events.title: Demo Update #1 — The Issues You Reported Are Fixed
events.summary: Your Excellencies, The demo has been live for a week. Thank you for playing — and even more for telling us about every issue you ran into, on the community hub, by email, and in messages. Today's update is mostly about fixing what you reported. Mini-battles: wrong portraits flashing for a split second at the start, and countdown numbers randomly changing size Korean: the year not showing on the growth screen, plus missing characters on buttons and the save panel Clicks misaligned with the cursor

events.title: General Jeon Demo Available Now
events.summary: Your Excellencies, The General Jeon demo is out today. It's free — download it right from the store page. New to the genre? Quick intro: General Jeon is a visual novel × turn-based life-raising game set against modern Korean history. You play as Jeon Du-heo and make the choices at every stage of his life — and this build takes you from a thatched hut in 1930 all the way to 1959. events.title: This time, loyalty is defined by you!
events.summary: General Jeon is a narrative-driven game set in a historical theme. Players will take on the role of Quan Duhe, revisiting that history of "loyalty" from a first-person perspective. This pioneer PV merely reveals the tip of the iceberg of that magnificent and turbulent era.All character names and place names in this work are fictional and have no correlation with real historical figures.This work does not express any political stance and is solely a fictional creation based on historical themes.
